title: Customer Service and Support
description:
We run a US-based, court-mandated, online education program that is completed by people who have driven under the influence of alcohol.   Program participants watch 11 stories from both victims and offenders, with each storyteller detailing how their lives were impacted by a choice to drive impaired.  Program participants are required to answer questions throughout the program to check for understanding and ensure their active participation.  Often, our participants begin the program feeling angry and frustrated, but by the end of the program they often feel empowered and hopeful in their ability to make safer choices in the future.



Program users are required to register, pay a fee and complete the program within a 5 day timeframe.  There are many steps from registration through program completion where a program user may need assistance or encouragement.  We field phone calls from participants needing help and support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and 365 days a year.  We are needing to hire one person with availability from 3:00pm EST to 11:00 pm EST (we are based on the east coast of the United States), Monday through Friday.  We are expecting a higher second employee for this role at a later date.  



It is important that this customer service and support professional can work with people over the phone who may be stressed, nervous, or even angry.  We pride ourselves on our empathetic approach to customer service and it is important to lead with compassion.  Our program graduates frequently share that the customer service and support they receive from us made a difference.  We want our customers to feel confident, understood and supported by the end of our conversation with them.  



Here are some of the things that you may have to help them with:

- Registration and Signing Up - wanting more information about the YouImpact program prior to paying, problems with payment not going through, coupon code eligibility, expired accounts and determining eligibility for reactivation, finding information required at the time of registration

- Completing the program - changing the program language, program navigation, wrong answer alerts

- Post-program concerns - proof of program completion for the court system



These are the skills and knowledge that the ideal candidate would need to posses:

- Strong verbal/phone and written English communication skills - support is split between phone calls and
s

- Comfortable communicating with people of varying abilities and communication styles

- Follow communication “scripts” when handling different topics - but be able to put your personal touch on the interaction

- Ability to independently trouble-shoot technical issues

- In order to communicate with our customers, you will need consistent/high-quality internet access.

- Familiarity with CRM systems and practices - we use HubSpot

- E-Mail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Voice



It is expected that there will be lots of questions and a frequent need for clarification by the person hired.  If you are not comfortable asking for assistance, this is not the position for you.  We will make ourselves available to you frequently to support you.  



Our program works, and we have data that shows we have the lowest r
 rate of all available programs.  Currently, we have 16,000 people a year take our program.  We want people to use our program because it saves lives. Our company’s founder lost her infant child to an impaired driver and she developed this program to be an inspiration for change because showing compassion is truly how we help people do better.  We do not subscribe to the idea that you can shame or punish away bad behavior and this is reflected in how we interact with customers.

title: Backend / Operations Manager
description:
About us

We run a portfolio of fast-growing e-commerce brands across Australia, the UK, US and Canada. Our flagship is a designer lighting brand; the portfolio also spans fashion and home. We're profitable and scaling hard — which means the operational side now needs a dedicated owner instead of being run off the founder's desk.



The role in one line

Own the day-to-day backend of every store so the operation runs cleanly without the founder in the loop — and turn the money we currently lose to refunds, chargebacks and fulfilment issues into margin we keep.

This is not a ticket-closing job. You'll run the operation and improve the systems behind it. Right now roughly 15% of profit leaks to refunds and related issues. Your core mandate is to bring that down meaningfully (target: under 5%) through better process, not just faster firefighting.



What you'll own

Fulfilment & orders — Make sure every paid order ships within 48 hours, supplier transit times are met, and no order ever sits open. D
 on substitutions and out-of-stock situations using our playbook.

Refunds — Apply our refund decision matrix (replacement-first where appropriate, store credit before cash, cause-based logic). Approve within your limit; escalate above it. Tag every refund by cause and whether it was preventable.

Customer support quality — You don't do the CS yourself; you run quality control over a distributed support team. Monitor first response time, enforce correct template usage, make sure refund/issue tickets get prioritised and resolved fast.

Chargebacks — Respond within processor deadlines with proper evidence, and — more importantly — find the root causes and seal the leaks. Keeping our chargeback rate healthy is a priority.

Data & optimisation — Own data integrity across our sheets and dashboards. Surface where the leakage concentrates (which supplier, SKU, market) and propose the one or two fixes that move the number each month. This is the part of the job that actually compounds.



KPIs you'll be measured on

- Refund cost as % of profit (by cause) — trending down

- Customer first response time within target

- % of issue tickets resolved within 3 exchanges

- Chargeback count and % preventable

- Orders processed within 48h / supplier SLA hit rate

- Data completeness across all tracking



You're a fit if you:

- Have run operations or backend for a Shopify / dropshipping business before (multi-store and multi-market is a strong plus)

Are comfortable with the stack: Shopify, Google Merchant Center, a CS platform (we use Re:amaze),
/Klaviyo, spreadsheets/dashboards, Notion

- Think in systems — you instinctively turn a recurring problem into a rule or a process, not a repeated manual fix

- Are fully fluent in written English and excellent at concise, no-fluff async communication

- Are reliable, self-directed, and able to make decisions inside clear guardrails without checking in constantly

- Are numbers-literate — margins, COG, refund rates, chargeback rates mean something to you



Nice to have: experience disputing chargebacks, supplier/SLA management and comfort with custom dashboards.



How we work:

- Fully remote, full-time.

- Async-first. You'll run a short daily written standup, a weekly KPI report, and a monthly optimisation note. Real-time messages are reserved for genuine escalations.

- You get a clear SOP (decision matrix) from day one and a structured onboarding where you take over tasks in phases over your first 8 weeks.

- We measure you on outcomes, not hours online.

title: Short-Form Video Editor | Organic TikTok Style
description:
Exchange Life · Video Editing Team · Fully Remote



About the Role



At Exchange Life we sell collectible country flag charms, keychains, and bracelets for travelers. We're one of the fastest-growing DTC travel jewelry brands in the US, and we run a fully remote content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators across the world.



We're scaling our ad creative operation and need editors who can own their output and drive results, not just execute tasks. You'll work directly within our content team and the marketing team. This is not a gig, but a long-term partnership we want to build with you, just like we did with most of our editors who have been with us for over a year and a half.



What Success Looks Like



At Exchange Life, success is achieved when you're consistently making short-form videos with 50%+ hook rates and edits that keep people engaged. You understand what's working for the brand, and can own and iterate on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team.



Core Responsibilities



- Edit TikTok and Reels content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time, not just aesthetics

- Watch back your past edits and apply learnings to the new ones, constantly improving on them.

- Collaborate with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on what's working

- Turn around content quickly and communicate clearly on timelines, no constant check-ins required

- Be constantly aware of new TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them to your Exchange Life's videos where relevant.



Must-Haves



- At least one TikTok or Reel that crossed 500K views in the last 2 months, and you can explain what made it work

- Portfolio of 10+ short-form edits (TikTok or Reels only) from the last 30 days

- Owns their output, takes feedback and internalizes it, and doesn't repeat the same mistakes

- Able to look at metrics like hook rate, retention, watch time, and understand what you can improve on to make the video better

- Proficient in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

- Clear written and spoken English communication and ability to work independently



Nice-to-Haves



- Experience editing content for e-commerce brands

- Familiarity with adapting to different editing formats (text-on-screen, talking head, voiceover, etc...)



Not a Fit If



- Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

- You can't point to a recent viral video and explain why it did well

- You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

- You're looking for a short-term project



Compensation & Working Style



- Base rate:
PHP / hr

- Hours: ~35 hrs / week

- Schedule: Fully flexible, work whenever you want, as long as you meet deadlines

- Bonuses: Uncapped, performance-based, paid for views and ad spend

- Working style: no micromanagement



This is a long-term role. We invest in people who are committed, that includes access to courses, hardware, software, and 1-on-1 mentorship every day.



How to Apply



Fill out this form: 



Takes about 5 minutes. We check every application.

title: Customer Support
description:
Virtual Assistant for Mattress Store Customer Support & Lead Follow-Up



Job Title: Virtual Assistant for Customer Support



Company: Mattress Folks



Location: Remote



Hours: Part-time to start, with the potential to grow into more hours



About Us:



Mattress Folks is a local mattress store in Mauldin, South Carolina. We help customers find quality mattresses at discount prices. We pride ourselves in excellent customer service. 



A lot of our customer inquiries come through
 Marketplace,
 ads, social media messages, and other online channels. Customers often message us asking about mattress availability, pricing, comfort level, sizes, pickup, delivery, and store details.



We are looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant who can help us respond to incoming leads quickly, follow our messaging SOPs, and help turn conversations into store visits, phone calls, and sales opportunities.



What You’ll Be Doing:



Your main role will be monitoring our communication channels and helping us stay on top of customer conversations.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitoring
 Marketplace messages,
 ads leads, social media messages, and other communication channels

* Responding to incoming customer inquiries using our scripts and SOPs

* Asking the right follow-up questions to understand what the customer is looking for

* Helping customers with basic questions about mattress sizes, comfort levels, pricing, store hours, location, delivery, and availability (we will provide FAQ's)

* Following up with cold or unresponsive leads

* Keeping conversations organized so leads do not get missed

* Updating lead notes when needed

* Escalating important conversations to the store owner or sales team when necessary

* Learning our products, offers, common questions, and customer service style

* Helping improve response speed and consistency across all customer messages



Who We’re Looking For:



We are looking for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable communicating with customers in writing.



A great fit for this role would be someone who:



* Can learn SOPs quickly and follow them closely

* Can work independently without needing constant supervision

* Has strong written English

* Is friendly, professional, and helpful in customer conversations

* Understands that speed matters when responding to leads

* Is organized and able to keep track of many conversations at once

* Is comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

* Can follow up with leads in a way that feels helpful, not pushy

* Is willing to learn about mattresses, pricing, and our store process

* Has experience with customer service, sales support, appointment setting, or lead follow-up



Important Skills:



Please apply if you have experience with some or all of the following:



*
 Marketplace messages

*
 Business Suite / Meta Business Suite

* Customer support

* Lead follow-up

* Chat support

* Sales support

* CRM or spreadsheet tracking

* Written English communication

* Following scripts and SOPs



Experience in furniture, mattresses, retail, e-commerce, or local service businesses is a plus, but not required.



What Success Looks Like:



You are successful in this role when:



* Customer messages are answered quickly

* Leads are followed up with consistently

* Conversations are organized and not forgotten

* Customers feel helped, not pressured

* The sales team has better-quality conversations because you gathered helpful information first

* You are able to follow our process while also using good judgment



Schedule:



We are looking for someone who can check messages consistently during assigned hours. Because many of our leads come in throughout the day, responsiveness is very important.



Please include your availability in your application.



How to Apply:



Please send a short message answering the following questions:



1. What customer support or lead follow-up experience do you have?

2. Have you ever managed
 Marketplace,
 Business Suite, or social media messages?

3. How would you respond if a customer simply says, “Is this mattress still available?”

4. What hours are you available to work?

5. Why do you think you would be a good fit for this role?



Please include the word “MATTRESS” in the first line of your application so we know you read the full job post.



We are looking for someone long-term who can grow with us, learn our process, and become a dependable part of our team.

A successful consultant will challenge assumptions when appropriate and help us make better decisions.



We value thoughtful feedback more than blind agreement.

mbers will actually use

Saga Accounting Solutions is a US-based accounting and tax firm serving small business owners, with a growing focus on landscaping companies across the United States. We provide bookkeeping, tax preparation, and advisory services. We are a small, high-performing team that values accuracy, ownership, and clear communication.



ROLE SUMMARY

We’re looking for a full-time Philippines-based Senior US Tax Accountant to help prepare and perform first-pass reviews of US individual and business tax returns. Work hours are flexible with 3 hour daily overlap hours required. 



Your main outcome: Accurately prepare and conduct initial review of tax returns to reduce the owner's review time per return. You will work on US clients only, coordinating closely with the owner (an Enrolled Agent).



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1) Prepare and perform first-pass review of US tax returns:

     - Individuals: Form 1040 (including Schedule C, Schedule E where applicable)

     - Businesses: Primarily Form 1065 and 1120S, some 1120

2) Build clear, organized workpapers for each engagement:

     - Tie-outs to trial balances for entity returns

     - Supporting schedules (depreciation, loans, equity/basis, etc.)

3) Identify missing information and prepare concise question lists for the owner / client.

4) Draft responses to IRS and state notices following firm templates and guidance (owner will finalize).

5) Follow firm checklists and SOPs to ensure consistent quality and reduce review time.

6) Maintain accurate status updates and time tracking for all assigned returns.

7) Communicate proactively with the team via
/Slack and our practice management system.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

- Minimum 3 years recent experience preparing US tax returns in a public accounting or BPO setting.

- Hands-on experience with Individual returns (Form 1040 + common schedules) and Entity returns (Form 1065 and/or 1120S)

- Proficient with QBO

- Experience with at least one major US tax software (Drake Tax and CCH Axcess are a plus).

- Strong written English; able to draft clear internal notes and client-facing
 drafts.

- High attention to detail and ability to follow checklists and procedures.

- Stable internet connection and ability to work with overlap in US business hours (at least 3 hours per day).



NICE TO HAVE:

-Experience with US small businesses in trades/contracting/landscaping or similar industries.

-Prior work for a fully virtual US accounting / tax firm.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary in PHP based on experience (to be discussed).

- Fully remote role with a small, collaborative team.

- Direct mentorship from a US Enrolled Agent.

- Opportunity for stable, long-term employment and increased responsibility over time.



WORK SCHEDULE & TOOLS

- Full-time, remote.

- Required overlap with US business hours (e.g., late afternoon/evening PH time).

- We primarily use: QuickBooks Online, Drake Tax, Tallyfor, Google Workspace, and Financial Cents Practice Management System.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit the following (in English):

1) Your CV/resume.

2) A short cover letter answering:

3) How many US returns did you personally prepare last tax season (break down 1040 / 1065 / 1120S / 1120)?

4) Which tax software have you used, and for how many seasons?

5) Describe the typical US clients you’ve worked with (industry, size, entity types).



 your application to: 
 with subject line:

“Application – Senior US Tax Accountant (PH)”

Creating new Reddit accounts according to our process

Building karma gradually through genuine comments and posts

Tracking account age, karma, activity, and status

Monitoring whether accounts are restricted, banned, shadowbanned, or flagged

Participating in suitable subreddits in a natural way

Posting comments that feel relevant, helpful, and human

Publishing posts only when accounts are ready and suitable

Sending an end-of-day report every working day

Age of the accounts

Number of accounts created today

Number of accounts warmed up today

Number of accounts in each karma range:

0–100 karma

101–500 karma

501–1,000 karma

1,000+ karma

Number of banned, restricted, or shadowbanned accounts

Number of comments posted

Number of posts published

Which accounts were worked on

Any issues, warnings, removals, or unusual activity

What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate has:



Experience creating and managing Reddit accounts

A good understanding of Reddit culture

Ability to warm up accounts without looking spammy

Strong written English

Ability to write natural comments in different communities

Good attention to detail

Reliability with daily reporting

Experience managing multiple accounts at once

Understanding of karma, account age, subreddit rules, and account health

Important



We are looking for someone who understands how to build Reddit accounts carefully and gradually. The priority is account quality, safety, consistency, and long-term usability.



This is not a spam-posting role. We need someone who can manage accounts properly, avoid obvious patterns, follow instructions, and provide clear reporting every day.

We're Strid CRM, a GoHighLevel-based platform built specifically for real estate and land investors. Our mission is to make sure every client who joins us not only stays, but actually runs a better business because of it.



As we scale, we're looking for a Customer Success Manager who combines genuine people skills with deep platform knowledge. You will be the person our clients rely on when they need help, and the person we rely on to keep them from leaving.



This role requires real GoHighLevel expertise. You will be configuring sub-accounts, troubleshooting automations, guiding A2P registration, and running technical onboarding calls every week. If that excites you, keep reading.



What You'll Do



Onboard every new customer, hands-on.

You lead 1:1 onboarding calls with new subscribers and walk them through the full technical setup: pipeline configuration, custom fields, lead imports, phone number setup, call forwarding, A2P/10DLC SMS registration, and the AI agent. You will also guide customers migrating from platforms like Pebble, Follow Up Boss, Podio, and Salesforce. The goal is to get each customer to their "aha 
nt," the point where the platform clicks, as fast as possible.



Monitor account health and get ahead of churn.

You track every account weekly using GoCSM, segmenting customers into health tiers. When someone goes quiet, you reach out before they cancel. When someone does cancel, you have the retention conversation, collect the real feedback, and d
 whether a save is possible. You own the outcome either way.



Handle the hard technical stuff.

You are the escalation point for complex platform issues: broken automations, phone porting failures, Zapier integration bugs, lead routing problems, and snapshot rollouts. You coordinate with the dev and ops team when something needs to go deeper, and you document the fix so it doesn't happen again.



Manage a small support team.

You oversee one or two GHL support reps who handle first-line tickets. You train them, write their SOPs, hold them accountable, and make sure client issues get resolved without needing to escalate everything to you.



Build training resources and documentation.

You create training modules for customers on features like Smart Lists, automations, and pipeline management. You maintain SOPs for your own role. You contribute to group training calls when needed.



Be the voice of the customer internally.

You join a weekly alignment call with the CEO to review account health, churn signals, and product friction. The best product improvements we've made have come from this feedback loop, and that will continue with you in this seat.



What We're Looking For



Deep GoHighLevel experience: this is the job.

You need to be able to build and troubleshoot workflows, configure sub-accounts, manage snapshots, set up smart lists, and guide customers through A2P registration without Googling it. "Comfortable with GHL" is not enough for this role.



Excellent English communication.

Confident and warm on Zoom calls. Clear and professional in writing. Most of your clients are US-based operators who are not particularly technical; you need to explain complex setups in plain language without making anyone feel lost.



A proactive mindset.

You do not wait for tickets. You notice when a customer has not logged in for two weeks and you pick up the phone. You flag churn risk before it becomes a cancellation.



Organized and reliable.

You follow through, document what you do, and take ownership of your accounts without needing to be chased.



Requirements

- 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or SaaS Support

- Deep hands-on GoHighLevel experience (required: will be tested in the interview)

- Working knowledge of A2P / 10DLC SMS registration and phone porting

-  Experience building and troubleshooting GHL automations, workflows, and smart lists

- Comfortable running daily screen-share video calls with clients

- Strong written and spoken English

- Experience managing or mentoring junior support staff

- Availability to overlap with US Eastern or Central time



Bonus Points

- Experience in land investing, real estate acquisition, or a related industry

- Familiarity with GoCSM or similar customer health tools

- Experience with Zapier or n8n integrations

- Background migrating clients from Pebble, Follow Up Boss, Podio, or Salesforce



Why Strid



We are a focused, fast-moving team with a clear niche and a growing client base. You will not be one of fifty CSMs working from a script. You will have real ownership, a direct line to leadership, and the ability to shape how customer success works here as we scale. This role has genuine growth potential; the person who grows with us will eventually lead the entire CS function.



Compensation & Details

- Full-time (part-time considered for exceptional candidates)

- Remote, global applicants welcome

- Competitive rate based on experience and communication fluency

- Direct reporting relationship to CEO



How to Apply



Submit the following using the application form below:




/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdlzmYD0tRqEW7Bx1UbDHTX22MHVn0Ow4SrIgYQ30VId5votA/viewform



1. Your resume

2. A professional photo

3. A 1 to 2 minute Loom video answering these two questions:



* Walk us through a GHL setup or troubleshooting situation you handled recently. What was the problem, and how did you resolve it?

* How would you handle a client who is two weeks in, hasn't logged in once, and missed their onboarding call?



We review every submission personally. If your Loom shows us someone who knows GHL and genuinely cares about clients, we will be in touch quickly.

title: Senior HR Hiring Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced Senior HR Hiring Manager to build and manage our tutoring team across multiple family-based locations and remote positions.

You will be responsible for:

• Recruiting qualified math tutors who fit with family learning environments

• Screening candidates for teaching ability and family compatibility

• Building lasting tutor-family matches that drive measurable student success

• Managing hiring across MathWorldWide and expanding our team

This role requires someone with a proven track record of successful hiring, team building, and working with education/tutoring professionals.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

RECRUITMENT & CANDIDATE SOURCING

Post and manage job listings on job boards

Source qualified math tutors through multiple channels

Screen resumes and applications efficiently

Conduct initial interviews and background checks

CANDIDATE ASSESSMENT & MATCHING

Evaluate teaching experience and expertise (through interviews and portfolio review)

Assess cultural fit and family interaction skills

Verify educational qualifications and certifications

Identify candidates capable of adapting to different learning styles

FAMILY-TUTOR PLACEMENT

Match qualified tutors with family needs and preferences

Conduct follow-up assessments of placements

Gather feedback from families on tutor performance

Make adjustments to placements based on results

HIRING PIPELINE MANAGEMENT

Maintain organized candidate database

Track time-to-hire and quality metrics

Generate reports on hiring effectiveness

Forecast staffing needs based on growth

ONBOARDING & SUCCESS TRACKING

Coordinate orientation and training for new hires

Ensure tutors understand family expectations

Monitor first 30/60/90 days of placement success

Maintain records of tutor performance and student outcomes

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

ESSENTIAL SKILLS:

3+ years of hiring and recruitment experience

Proven success recruiting for education/tutoring sector (preferred)

Experience with job boards (Indeed, LinkedIn, etc.)

Strong interview and assessment skills

Ability to identify cultural fit and soft skills

Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic tracking systems

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Ability to work independently and manage multiple candidates simultaneously

NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS:

HR certification (SHRM, etc.)

Experience with Thumbtack or service-based platforms

Teaching background or education industry knowledge

Familiarity with remote hiring processes

Data analysis and reporting skills

Experience with family-based service matching

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

TRACK RECORD THAT SHOWS:

Successfully hired tutors or education professionals who lasted 6+ months

Numbers: "I recruited X tutors and achieved Y% placement success rate"

Experience reducing time-to-hire or improving candidate quality

Examples of difficult hiring situations you solved

Feedback from past employers about your hiring accuracy

WORK STYLE DEMONSTRATES:

Detail-oriented and organized (manages multiple candidates without dropping balls)

Results-focused (cares about placement outcomes, not just filling positions)

Communication skills (interviews well, explains feedback clearly)

Problem-solving (handles mismatches, finds creative sourcing)

Self-starter (requires minimal supervision)

title: Senior Graphics & Packaging Designer — Own the Visual Identity of Two Brands
description:
**Company:** Intent Brands (two brands: Aerotrunk + SurviveX)

**Location:** Remote (Philippines preferred)

**Type:** Full-time (40 hrs/week)

**Compensation:** $2,000 USD/month + 13th month pay

**Start:** Immediately



---



## About Us



Intent Brands runs two consumer product brands sold on Amazon and our own Shopify store:



- **SurviveX** — Premium first aid and emergency preparedness kits. Medical/tactical aesthetic. Clean, confident, authoritative design language. Colors: Red (#E30829), Black (#1A1A1A), Dark Gray (#3D3D3D), White.

- **Aerotrunk** — Premium hardside luggage. Modern, aspirational travel lifestyle aesthetic.



We're a small, fast-moving team. You won't be "the designer who gets handed mockups to resize." You'll own the entire visual output for both brands — from packaging dielines to Amazon A+ content to social media assets. Your work will be on shelves, in search results, and in customers' hands.



---



## What You'll Actually Do (Weekly)



- **Packaging design** — Retail-ready packaging, inserts, labels, and stickers. You'll work directly with dieline templates from our manufacturers and deliver print-ready files (CMYK, bleeds, crop marks, PDF/X-1a or AI).

- **Amazon listing images** — Main images, infographics, lifestyle composites, comparison charts, and A+ Content modules. You understand Amazon's image requirements and what converts.

- **Brand store pages** — Design and maintain Amazon Brand Store layouts for both brands.

- **Shopify assets** — Homepage banners, collection images,
 campaign graphics.

- **Social media** — Instagram, TikTok,
 creative. Static and motion graphics.

- **Product photography direction** — You may not shoot photos, but you'll composite, retouch, and art-direct product imagery using renders, stock, and AI-generated elements.

- **Brand consistency** — Maintain and evolve brand guidelines for two very different brands simultaneously.



---



## What We're Looking For



This is a **senior role**. We're not looking for someone who can use Photoshop — we're looking for someone whose portfolio makes us say "we need to hire this person before someone else does."



### Must-Have Skills

- **Packaging design** — You've designed retail packaging that went to print. You know dielines, bleeds, safe zones, overprint, spot colors, and substrate considerations. You've dealt with manufacturer feedback and revised files for production.

- **Amazon content** — You've created listing images and A+ content that you can show us. You understand what converts on Amazon (not just what looks pretty).

- **Print production** — CMYK, Pantone, PDF/X, press-ready files. You know the difference between RGB mockups and production-ready artwork.

- **Adobe Creative Suite mastery** — Illustrator (packaging, vector), Photoshop (compositing, retouching), InDesign (inserts, guides). These are your daily tools, not occasional ones.

- **Typography & layout** — You have strong opinions about type hierarchy, spacing, and readability at small scales (packaging, labels, inserts).



### Strong Plus

- **Motion graphics** — After Effects or similar for social content, product animations

- **3D mockups** — Blender, Dimension, or similar for product visualization

- **AI image tools** — Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, or similar for concepting and asset generation

- **Figma** — For collaborative design, UI work, or rapid prototyping

- **Medical/health product design** — Experience with FDA-regulated labels (Drug Facts panels, mandatory copy)

- **Bilingual English** — Your English needs to be strong enough to read briefs, present concepts, and explain design decisions in writing



---



## Screening Questions (Answer All 4)



> **Include the phrase "I design for production" somewhere in your application.** This tells us you read the full listing.



### Q1: Packaging Portfolio Piece

Show us one packaging project you're most proud of — something that went to physical production. Tell us:

- What was the product?

- What were the print specs and constraints?

- What was your process from concept to final production file?

- Show the final printed result (photo of the physical product) alongside your design file if possible.



### Q2: Amazon Listing Challenge

Pick one of these two scenarios and walk us through how you'd approach it:



**Option A:** Our first aid kit's main image has a 3% click-through rate (below category average of 4.5%). The current image is a straight product shot on white. What would you change and why? What would you A/B test first?



**Option B:** We need to create 7 listing images for a new luggage product. Walk us through what each image slot would contain and why, based on what you know converts on Amazon.



### Q3: Two Brands, One Designer

SurviveX is medical/tactical (red, black, authoritative). Aerotrunk is travel/lifestyle (modern, aspirational, premium). How do you switch between two very different brand identities without the work starting to look the same? Give us a specific technique or process you use.



### Q4: Tools & Speed

What's your full design stack? For each major tool, tell us honestly: daily driver, weekly, or occasional? Also: what's your typical turnaround for a set of 7 Amazon listing images from brief to final delivery?



---



## Paid Test Task



Instead of multiple interview rounds, we'll ask our shortlisted candidates to complete a **paid design test** ($75 USD). This lets us evaluate real work, not interview performance.



The test will involve:

- Redesigning one existing Amazon listing image set (3 images) for SurviveX

- Creating one packaging insert concept (front/back) based on a provided dieline and brief



You'll receive brand guidelines, existing assets, and a clear brief. We're looking for design quality, brand interpretation, production-readiness, and turnaround speed.



---



## What You Get



- **$2,000 USD/month** — paid biweekly, direct deposit

- **13th month pay** — standard Philippine labor benefit

- **Paid time off** — Philippine holidays + 15 days personal leave

- **Creative ownership** — You're not a pixel-pusher. You'll influence brand direction.

- **Small team** — Direct access to founders. No layers of middle management. Your ideas get heard.

- **Growth** — As the brands grow, you grow. This could become a design lead / creative director path.



---



## How to Apply



1. Answer all 4 screening questions above

2. Include the phrase "I design for production"

3. Link your portfolio (Behance, Dribbble, personal site, or Google Drive — we don't care where, we care what's in it)

4. Include at least 2 examples of **physical product packaging** you designed (not mockups — actual printed products)

5. Tell us your rate expectation and availability



**Applications without portfolio links or screening answers will not be reviewed.**



We review applications within 48 hours. Shortlisted candidates will receive the paid test task within one week.

title: AI Infrastructure Lead — E-Commerce (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
**About Us**



We're Intent Brands — a US-based e-commerce company running two growing brands on Shopify and Amazon. We're building an AI-first operations layer and need someone to own it.



This isn't a virtual assistant role. This is a technical leadership position where you'll design, build, and maintain the AI and automation systems that run our business — from customer workflows to marketing pipelines to internal tools.



We already use Claude and a suite of AI agents. We need someone who can take what we've started and make it run like a machine.



**What You'll Do**



- Design and build automated workflows using Claude and PaperClip

- Manage and improve our AI agent infrastructure (Claude-based agents, PaperClip AI hub)

- Connect our tools — Shopify, Amazon, Klaviyo, Apollo, Google Workspace — into intelligent, automated pipelines

- Write clear documentation and SOPs for every system you build

- Identify manual processes across the business and propose automation solutions

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize existing automations

- Stay current on AI developments and recommend tools/approaches that give us an edge



**What We're Looking For**



- Hands-on experience building automations with n8n, Make, or similar workflow tools

- Real working knowledge of AI/LLMs — not just "I've used ChatGPT," but understanding of prompting, agents, APIs, context management, and when to use what

- Comfortable working with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and integrating third-party services

- Experience with e-commerce platforms (Shopify, Amazon, or similar) is a strong advantage

- Basic scripting ability (Python or JavaScript) — enough to write a webhook handler or parse JSON, not full-stack development

- Self-directed and organized — you'll have autonomy, and we expect you to use it well

- Strong written English — you'll be writing documentation, prompts, and internal communications daily



**Bonus Points For**



- Experience with OpenClaw, Claude Code, or Codex

- Familiarity with Shopify APIs, Liquid, or webhooks

- Knowledge of Klaviyo, 
, Semrush, or marketing automation tools

- Experience managing multi-agent AI systems

- Understanding of prompt engineering and system prompt design



**What We Offer**



- $1,500/month, full-time (40 hrs/week)

- 3-month probationary period, then permanent position

- Work directly with the founders — small team, big impact

- Access to cutting-edge AI tools (we invest in the best)

- Room to grow as our AI infrastructure scales



---



## Application Questions:



**IMPORTANT: Please answer ALL of the following questions in your application. Applications without answers will not be considered.**



1. **Describe a workflow or automation you built that you're proud of.** What was the business problem? What tools did you use? What was the result? (Be specific — "I automated social media posting" is not enough.)



2. **You need to connect a Shopify store to a 
 channel so that every time a customer places an order over $100, the team gets notified with the customer's name, order total, and whether they're a first-time or returning buyer. Walk us through how you'd set this up.** (We want to see your thinking process, not just "I'd use n8n.")



3. **What is the difference between using an AI agent and using a simple API call to an LLM? When would you choose one over the other?** (This tells us if you actually understand AI infrastructure or just use chatbots.)



4. **What is your experience with n8n and Claude Code specifically? OpenClaw Experience is good as well.** If none, what workflow/automation tool have you used most, and what's the most complex thing you built with it?



5. **Include the phrase "I build systems" somewhere in your application.** (This helps us confirm you read the full listing.)

title: Virtual assistant - Commercial cleaning company
description:

description:

- Understand Target Audience: Conduct research to understand the pain points, needs, ambitions, and decision-making drivers of gigCMO’s target audience, including start-ups, scale-ups, SMEs, founders, business owners, and senior decision-makers seeking strategic marketing leadership and revenue growth.

- Implement Effective SEO Practices: Conduct keyword optimisation and create customer-centric website copy that improves search visibility, attracts qualified prospects, and supports gigCMO’s positioning as a growth consultancy.

- Conduct Competitor Analysis: Study the messaging, positioning, and copywriting techniques of competitors, fractional CMO providers, marketing consultancies, and relevant growth advisory businesses to identify best practices, market gaps, and opportunities to strengthen gigCMO’s communications.

- Create Engaging Content: Develop attention-grabbing subject lines, headlines, calls to action, website copy, landing page copy, campaign messaging, and thought leadership content that encourages engagement and conversion.

- Master the Company’s Product/Service: Build a deep understanding of gigCMO’s services, including strategic marketing leadership, fractional CMO support, growth consultancy, go-to-market strategy, playbook-driven marketing, knowledge transfer, and marketing capability development.

- Translate Strategic Services into Clear Messaging: Simplify complex marketing, growth, and consultancy concepts into clear, commercially relevant, and customer-focused copy that resonates with business leaders.

- Collaborate with Lead Gen and HubSpot Teams: Work closely with the Lead Generation and HubSpot teams to align copy with campaign strategies, CRM workflows, customer journeys, sales funnels, and revenue growth objectives.

- Optimise for Performance: Continuously test and optimise copy to improve open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, engagement, lead quality, and overall campaign performance.

- Report on Copy Performance: Synthesise copy performance data and insights into actionable recommendations for campaign optimisation, messaging improvements, and future copy strategy.

- Maintain Brand Consistency: Ensure all copy reflects gigCMO’s brand positioning, tone of voice, value proposition, and focus on measurable business growth.

- Stay Up-to-Date: Keep up with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in copywriting, B2B marketing, SEO, outbound and inbound sales strategies, fractional marketing leadership, and AI-assisted marketing workflows.



Primary Brand Focus:

You will primarily write copy for gigCMO, a growth consultancy that provides strategic marketing leadership and expertise to start-ups, scale-ups, and SMEs to help drive profitable revenue growth.



Your work will support gigCMO’s own marketing, lead generation, website,
 campaigns, social media, thought leadership, sales enablement, and client-facing communications. The copy should clearly communicate gigCMO’s value proposition: helping businesses turn marketing into a structured, measurable growth engine through marketing leadership, playbook-driven execution, and knowledge transfer.



You will also support copywriting initiatives across selected client brands or related projects as needed.



Qualifications:

- Marketing and Sales Experience: Proven understanding of marketing and sales principles, with a track record of crafting copy that drives action, supports lead generation, and contributes to measurable commercial outcomes.

- Research Skills: Ability to conduct thorough research and synthesise information into clear, compelling, and customer-focused narratives for B2B audiences.

- Proven Copywriting Experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience in copywriting, content writing, marketing communications, or related fields.

- Strong Writing Skills: Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to adapt tone and style across different channels, audiences, and stages of the marketing funnel.

- Creativity: Innovative thinker with the ability to generate unique ideas, messaging angles, campaign concepts, and copy that differentiates gigCMO in the market.

- Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Lead Generation, HubSpot, marketing, sales, and leadership teams.

- Time Management: Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and deadlines.

- Analytical Skills: Proficient in using analytics tools to extract and measure copy performance metrics, including open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, engagement data, lead quality, and search visibility.

- Data-driven Thinking Skills: Ability to interpret, evaluate, and synthesise data findings and insights to inform strategic decisions, identify patterns, and improve copy, messaging, and campaign performance.

- Product/Service Knowledge: Ability to rapidly build a deep understanding of gigCMO’s services and translate strategic marketing, fractional CMO, growth consultancy, and capability-building concepts into compelling, customer-centric narratives.

- Strategic Vision: Ability to position each piece of copy within the broader context of the campaign strategy, marketing funnel, customer journey, sales process, and brand identity, recognising that copy does not exist in isolation.

- Commercial Awareness: Strong understanding of how marketing supports revenue growth, lead generation, customer acquisition, and long-term business capability.

- B2B Communication Skills: Ability to write confidently for founders, business owners, senior executives, and decision-makers across start-ups, scale-ups, and SMEs.

title: Remote Desktop Technician
description:
Location: Remote | Full-Time (US Business Hours, CST)

Company: Lockbaud



- About the Role -



Lockbaud is seeking a Remote Desktop Technician to provide technical support to a coast-to-coast U.S.-based user base. This role involves frequent live interaction with end users and requires excellent spoken and written English, strong communication skills, and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and confidently.



The technician will support primarily Microsoft-based environments and must be comfortable learning new systems and troubleshooting a wide variety of issues. One ticket may involve installing a printer driver. The next may require diagnosing a VoIP phone problem. Success in this role depends on curiosity, adaptability, and clear communication as much as technical ability.

- Communicate clearly and professionally with users, setting expectations and explaining technical issues in plain language

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues on Windows workstations and peripherals

- Support Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and user account-related issues

- Install and configure printer drivers, software applications, and system updates

- Assist with troubleshooting VoIP phone systems, including device configuration, connectivity, and basic call quality issues

- Use remote access and RMM tools to diagnose and remediate endpoint issues

- Document troubleshooting steps, findings, and resolutions accurately in the ticketing system

- Escalate complex issues with clear context and supporting details

- Collaborate with Lead Technician and Dispatch to maintain efficient ticket flow



- Required Skills & Traits -



- Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate confidently over the phone

- Strong customer-facing communication skills; ability to work directly with a U.S.-based user population

- Willingness to learn and take ownership of unfamiliar technical issues

- Experience in a technical support or service desk role, or equivalent hands-on technical experience

- Working knowledge of Windows operating systems

- Ability to remain calm, clear, and professional (and upbeat) during live support interactions



- Preferred Qualifications -



- Familiarity with Microsoft 365 environments

- Basic understanding of networking concepts (connectivity, DNS awareness, VoIP fundamentals)

- Prior experience providing phone-based technical support to U.S. customers

- Familiarity with VoIP phone systems and endpoint hardware

- Experience supporting printers and peripheral devices

- MSP or multi-client support experience

- Clear, neutral, or American-accented English (for phone-based support roles)



- What Success Looks Like -



- Users understand what you’re doing and why

- Issues are resolved efficiently without unnecessary escalation

- Documentation is thorough and useful to other technicians

- You handle unfamiliar problems methodically instead of freezing



- Why Lockbaud -



This role offers hands-on experience supporting real users in real environments. You’ll work directly with U.S.-based customers, gain exposure to Microsoft platforms, printers, and VoIP systems, and develop your technical and communication skills alongside experienced technicians.

- Submit a resume highlighting technical experience and customer-facing work

- Include a short voice recording to demonstrate phone communication skills

title: E-commerce Assistant Store Manager
description:
We operate three profitable E-commerce stores and are currently launching our fourth. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a highly experienced E-commerce Assistant Store Manager to handle day-to-day operations, support customers across multiple channels, and help keep our systems running smoothly.



This is a senior-level role with long-term potential for the right candidate. Please read the full job description and answer all questions for your application to be considered.



IMPORTANT: Please read the entire job description and follow the application instructions carefully to be considered.



Responsibilities

• Manage customer inquiries via phone,
, and chat with professionalism and accuracy.

• Handle RFQs, returns/exchanges, complaints, disputes, and negative reviews.

• Collect and maintain positive customer reviews and overall satisfaction.

• Support sales-related tasks and assist in improving store performance.

• Collaborate with the CS, Orders, and Product teams to share insights and ensure a consistent customer experience.

• Identify process gaps, recommend improvements, and contribute to SOP updates.

• Perform daily administrative tasks, including EOS reports and operational updates.

• Proactively manage assigned tasks without waiting for instructions.



What You Need to Succeed -



Required Experience:

• 2+ years in E-commerce operations (customer service + order management + product management).

• Proven Shopify experience (listings, inventory, bulk updates, app usage).

• Strong phone communication skills and ability to handle challenging conversations calmly.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong attention to detail (include the word mushroom in your application).



Technical Requirements:

• Proficiency in Shopify, ClickUp, Airtable, CRM tools, and Google Workspace.

• Reliable computer + 20 Mbps+ internet.

• Backup solutions for both power and internet outages.



Work Style:

• Self-directed - you take initiative and solve problems independently.

• Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy.

• Customer-focused - complaints are opportunities to improve systems.

• Process-minded - you document and refine workflows naturally.



Work Schedule:

• Full-time, 40 hours/week

• US business hours: 9 PM–6 AM or 10 PM–7 AM PHT

• 1-hour break

• Five days per week



You're NOT a Fit If:

• You need micromanagement or detailed daily task lists

• You can't work 9 PM–7 AM PHT consistently

• You experience frequent power/internet outages without backup solutions

• You view this as temporary income between other opportunities



Before You Apply - Please Confirm:

• Weekly payments for the first 4 weeks (starting from week 3), then bi-monthly every other Tuesday.

• Full-time role, US hours.

• Must be open to a two-month trial period.

• Daily End of Shift (EOS) report answering:

a) What did you do today? (detailed description)

b) What issues did you run into?

c) Anything you need help with?

If you agree to all terms, write “I AGREE TO ALL TERMS” and answer the questions below.



Application Instructions (Follow Exactly) -



Subject Line:

[Your First Name] – I Am Your New E-commerce Assistant Store Manager

Example: Kevin – I Am Your New E-commerce Assistant Store Manager



Submit:

• Cover letter (focused on relevant e-commerce experience)

• Resume



Answer These Questions (Complete Sentences Required):

1. Describe your most relevant e-commerce operations experience (platforms used, team size, order volume, responsibilities).

2. What specific Shopify tasks have you performed?

3. What are your current work commitments and availability?

4. Provide your internet speed (include screenshot), computer specifications, and backup solutions for power & internet issues.

5. Provide one example of a difficult customer situation you handled and how you resolved it.

6. Why are you interested in this specific role instead of other VA positions?



Important: AI-generated or template responses will be immediately disqualified. We're looking for thoughtful, specific answers that demonstrate you read and understood this posting.

title: Game Developer — Playable Ad Creative
description:
Cocos Developer — Playable Ad Creative

We make mobile games and we're looking for a developer to join our creative production team. Your job isn't building games from scratch — it's taking proven concepts from our existing title and producing high volumes of polished, self-contained playable ads in Cocos Creator: new layouts, fresh mechanics, visual tweaks, and gameplay variations that we can test as ad content across networks.

It's output-focused work by nature, but the best person for this role will bring genuine creative instinct to every build — understanding what makes a playable hook a viewer in the first two seconds, keep them engaged, and drive an install.

What You'll Be Doing



Building and iterating playable ad experiences in Cocos Creator based on scenes and mechanics from our existing title

Producing multiple creative variants from a single brief — new layouts, camera angles, UI treatments, and gameplay twists

Keeping every build under the 5MB file size limit, using CLI tooling to audit, profile, and optimise assets, scripts, and bundles systematically

Optimising 3D assets in Blender — decimating meshes, reducing poly counts, and preparing game-ready models that look great without breaking the size budget

Writing clean, modular code that can be rapidly forked and varied without bloat accumulating across iterations

Using AI coding assistants (Claude Code or equivalent) as a core part of your workflow — not occasionally, but as standard practice for boilerplate, refactoring, and problem-solving

Pitching and executing your own original playable concepts — exhilarating, interactive 
nts that retain users and perform as ad content

Working within an established codebase, reading and extending existing scripts confidently



What We're Looking For



Strong experience with Unity or Cocos Creator — if you know Unity well, Cocos is a short bridge and we'll support the transition

Demonstrated ability to use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) as a genuine accelerant in your programming workflow — this is non-negotiable

Hands-on experience using CLI tools to analyse and reduce build sizes: understanding what's eating your budget, stripping unused assets, compressing textures, and hitting hard size targets

Solid Blender skills with a focus on optimisation — you should be comfortable taking a mesh and stripping it down to the leanest version that still holds up visually in a real-time context

Comfortable working inside an existing project and codebase rather than building from zero

A creative eye — you should be able to look at a mechanic and have ideas, not just wait to be told what to change

Self-directed and productive working remotely with minimal hand-holding

Comfortable with repetitive, output-focused work without letting quality slip



Nice to Have



Existing Cocos Creator experience and familiarity with its build pipeline

Familiarity with mobile playable ad formats and what makes interactive ad content perform

Experience optimising for ad network playable specs (Meta, AppLovin, etc.)

Basic video or screen capture skills for documenting and sharing build previews



Salary & Growth

Starting salary is based on experience and portfolio. We review performance after an initial period, and those who demonstrate strong output and creative initiative can expect salary progression — this is a role where the right person can grow quickly.

Hours

For the first week or so, we'll ask you to work UK hours (10am–6pm) during an induction period so we can get you set up properly and answer questions in real time. Once you're settled, you'll have much more flexibility to work hours that suit you.

To Apply

Share your portfolio — Cocos or Unity projects, playables, or anything that shows your work in action. Interactive demos are ideal, but video or GIF walkthroughs of scenes or effects are great too. Tell us briefly about a project where you had to work within someone else's existing codebase, and how you use AI tools day-to-day in your development workflow.

title: Amazon & eBay Marketplace Manager | Product Listing Specialist
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Amazon & eBay Marketplace Manager to take full ownership of our product listings and marketplace performance across Amazon Seller Central and eBay Seller Hub.



This role is focused on end-to-end marketplace execution, including product listing creation, optimisation, pricing accuracy, inventory control, and ongoing account health management.



The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience working within Amazon and eBay seller platforms, with a deep understanding of how to structure listings for visibility, compliance, and conversion. This is not a basic upload role. It requires someone who can manage catalogue quality, optimise performance, and maintain operational accuracy across both marketplaces.



You will work closely with internal teams to ensure product data, stock levels, and pricing are consistently accurate and aligned across all systems.



Key Responsibilities

1. Product Listing Management (Amazon & eBay)

• Create, update, and manage product listings across Amazon and eBay

• Ensure all listings are accurate, complete, and professionally structured

• Write and optimise product titles, bullet points, descriptions, and item specifics

• Assign correct categories, attributes, and product classifications

• Upload and manage product images, ensuring correct sequencing for conversion

• Maintain accurate product data including SKUs, barcodes, dimensions, weight, pricing, and delivery details

• Review existing listings and implement improvements to increase visibility and conversion rates

• Identify underperforming listings and execute corrective updates

• Maintain consistency of product data across Amazon, eBay, and internal systems



2. Amazon Seller Central Management

• Create and manage listings within Amazon Seller Central

• Build and maintain parent-child variation structures (size, colour, weight, bundle, etc.)

• Resolve listing issues including suppressed listings, inactive ASINs, and stranded inventory

• Manage product metadata including titles, bullets, descriptions, browse nodes, product IDs, and backend keywords

• Monitor listing health and account performance metrics

• Ensure compliance with Amazon catalogue policies and best practices

• Coordinate with internal teams to align stock availability and fulfilment settings

• Support ongoing optimisation to improve search ranking and conversion performance



3. eBay Seller Hub Management

• Create and manage listings within eBay Seller Hub

• Set up and maintain variation listings accurately

• Ensure all item specifics are fully completed and compliant with eBay requirements

• Manage listing content including titles, descriptions, pricing, images, shipping, and returns

• Monitor listing performance and implement improvements where needed

• Maintain accurate stock levels and availability

• Ensure compliance with eBay listing policies and marketplace standards

• Maintain clean, accurate, and commercially optimised listings



Additional Requirements

The successful candidate must demonstrate:

• Strong attention to detail and data accuracy

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Strong organisational and multitasking skills

• Proactive problem-solving and issue identification

• Clear communication with internal teams



Experience in any of the following will be highly advantageous:

• Amazon flat files and bulk uploads

• eBay listing tools and bulk editing

• Inventory management systems

• Marketplace SEO and conversion optimisation

• Products with variations (size, weight, bundles, multi-SKU structures)

• Experience with physical goods such as fitness, bulky items, or multi-variant catalogues



Working Hours

Flexible working arrangement, with expected overlap during UK business hours for coordination and communication.



How to Apply

Please send your application with the subject line: Amazon & eBay Specialist – [Your Full Name]



Include the following:

• Updated CV or resume

• Brief summary of your Amazon and eBay experience

• Examples of marketplaces, brands, or product categories you have managed



Candidates with proven hands-on experience managing Amazon and eBay marketplaces, particularly those with complex catalog structures and variation-heavy product ranges, will be prioritised.

Managing multiple client social media accounts and keeping content calendars up to date

description:

We are hiring a **high-performance outbound calling Virtual Assistant** to help grow our insurance agency.

* Comfortable speaking with both **agents and senior clients**

* Reliable internet + quiet work environment

* Available to work **U.S. EST hours**

* **$500/month base salary**

* **$2 per appointment set**

* **$4 per appointment that shows**

* Additional bonus for high-quality candidates (agents who show strong interest or move forward)



**Expected Earnings:**



* Most VAs earn **$800 – $1,400+ per month** based on performance

* Insurance or final expense industry

* Recruiting or hiring calls

* Experience with warm or aged leads

* CRM and SMS tools (Twilio preferred)

Please include:

2. Your outbound calling experience

3. Your daily call volume and average appointments set

4. Your availability (EST hours)

Send a **30-second voice recording** pretending you are calling a lead to schedule a **Career Overview appointment**.

This role is focused on **booking Career Overview appointments for agents** and **setting client appointments**. You must be confident, consistent, and comfortable making a high number of outbound calls daily.

title: Controller
description:
Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller!

Location: Remote / Work From Home

Reports to: CEO





About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe. 



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.





About the Role

We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO.



The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need.



At $11.5M in revenue and targeting $30M by 2028, our financial complexity is outpacing our financial infrastructure. We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports.









Core Responsibilities

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required.



Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models.



Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation.



Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO.



Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively.

Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits.



CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: 

-A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers.

-You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person.





Required Experience & Skills

-5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations

-Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it

-E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax

-Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision

-Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically

-US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles)

-Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets

-Payroll experience across multiple platforms

-Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables)

-Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform

-Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders





Nice-to-Have Experience

-Experience working remotely for a US-based company from the Philippines

-Exposure to sales tax compliance across multiple US states

-Experience using Notion (or similar task management software)

-EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity

-Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors





What We’re Really Looking For

-Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed:

-Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur.

-Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable.

-Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. No prompting required.

-Direct communication - you push back when something doesn’t look right.

-Reliability - when you say you’ll be available, you’re available. When you can’t be, you say so immediately.





Compensation Details & Schedule

-Compensation: TBD based on candidate experience. Target compensation will be requested during screening.

-Work Hours: 50 hours/week, Monday–Friday. Core overlap with US Eastern hours (9AM–5PM EST).

-Paid Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

-PTO: 1 week earned for every 6 months worked at the company

-Location: Remote / Work From Home





To Apply

Fill out the application form here: 



This application includes a number of questions in order to ensure we hire an outstanding candidate for this position, so please be advised in advance that it will take time to complete.



Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Qualified candidates will be contacted for interviews. Applications on OnlineJobs.ph, DMs, and messages sent via
 will not be reviewed.

title: Vibe Coding & Agentic Engineering (Startup)
description:
What we do



We run a venture studio building multiple operating ventures (web platforms, AI products, internal tools). We're building an ecosystem of AI agents from scratch, Claude, Codex, Cursor, MCP servers, custom pipelines, to design, build, ship, and maintain these ventures. We need someone who can plug into that ecosystem and become an operator inside it.



What is a "vibe coder"?



It is someone who builds working software by directing AI tools instead of typing every line by hand. You describe what you want, you read what the AI produces, you test it, you push back when it is wrong, you ship it. You do not need a CS degree but developers are a bonus***. You need taste, judgment, and the ability to learn fast.



What you will actually do**



- Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) to build and ship features across our ventures

- Orchestrate AI agents to run repeatable workflows (research, code review, content, deployment)

- Read code carefully enough to know when the AI is lying to you

- Run tests, fix bugs, deploy to Vercel / similar platforms

- Document what you build so the next AI session can pick up where you left off

- Work directly with the founder on whatever venture is hot that week



**Who we are looking for**



- Obsessed with AI tools, you already use ChatGPT or Claude daily for non-trivial work

- Can read JavaScript, Python, or TypeScript well enough to debug — you do not need to write it from scratch

- Comfortable in a terminal (git, npm, basic bash)

- Fast learner, when you hit something new, you figure it out in hours, not weeks

- Written English strong enough to write clear prompts and clear documentation

- Honest about what you do not know



**Bonus (not required)**



- Experience with Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, or similar modern web stacks

- Have shipped something, anything, built with AI assistance (show us)

- Familiar with MCP, agent frameworks, or n8n / Zapier-style orchestration



**How to apply**



Do not send a generic cover letter. Send:



1. A link to one thing you built with AI help (even small — a script, a site, a Chrome extension)

2. A 3-5 sentence description of how you used AI to build it and what went wrong

3. Your favorite AI tool right now and why

4. The phrase "good vibes" in your application headline so we know you read this far

5. An intro video explaining who you are and your work



Applications without these will be ignored.



*We are building a long-term home for the right person. If you are looking for a stable, intellectually demanding role where you learn the cutting edge of AI engineering on the job, apply.*

title: Content Writer (Fully Remote)
description:
About This Position



High Vibe PR is a boutique communications firm for companies and brands redefining the future of culture and technology. We've launched a $275M gaming fund, positioned platforms as the leaders in in-game UGC, and built thought leadership for some of the sharpest founders in AI and frontier tech. 



We're hiring a Content Writer based in the Philippines. This is a fully remote, 40-hour-a-week role.



This is a writing role at its core. You'll produce blog posts, thought leadership, and listicles that earn attention and actually rank. While we use AI for ideation and edits, we are looking for a writer that creates copy that reads like a smart human wrote it, not a content mill. We care about substance and search in equal measure, and we're looking for someone who can deliver both.



Does a strong hook and a headline that actually makes someone click get you excited?



Can you take a dense, technical topic and turn it into something a busy founder wants to read to the end?



Do you know your way around SEO, keywords, structure, search intent, without letting it flatten your voice?



Do you have experience creating content for different types of formats?



If that sounds like you, let's talk.



Responsibilities



I. Content

- Write blog posts, thought leadership bylines, and listicles for clients across AI, frontier tech, and gaming

- Apply SEO best practices — keyword research, search intent, structure, internal linking — so our content gets found

- Research industries, trends, and writers deeply enough to write with authority on each client's space

- Match the voice of each client and executive you're writing for, from punchy founder takes to measured CMO bylines

- Track content performance and use what you learn to make the next piece better



II. Collaboration

Requirements

- 7–10 years of professional content writing experience

- Strong SEO background, with a track record of content that ranks and converts

Unique opportunities. From a team off-site in Bali to VIP tickets at the Eras Tour, we know how to mix work with incredible experiences.

title: UX Designer – eCommerce & Conversion Rate Optimization
description:
We are looking for a UX Designer who truly understands how users behave — and how great design directly drives revenue.



This role is NOT about making things look pretty. It's about making things WORK.



---



WHO WE ARE



We are a performance-driven eCommerce team. Every design decision we make is measured by one question: Does it convert? We believe in data-backed design, clean user flows, and removing every possible barrier between a visitor and a purchase. UX at our company is a growth tool — not a decoration department.



---



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Design and optimize UX flows for eCommerce stores (product pages, PDPs, checkout, cart, landing pages)

- Identify conversion bottlenecks and propose testable, hypothesis-driven solutions

- Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups in Figma

- Conduct UX audits on existing stores and present actionable improvements

- Collaborate closely with our team to implement and A/B test design changes

- Stay current with eCommerce UX best practices, CRO frameworks, and buyer psychology



---



OUR UX PRINCIPLES (Read carefully — this defines how we work)



1. Function over aesthetics. A beautiful design that doesn't convert is a failed design. Every element must serve a purpose.

2. Less friction, more revenue. We remove every unnecessary click, scroll, and decision from the user's path to purchase.

3. Design for the user, not for yourself. We don't care if something looks clever. We care if it works for real customers.

4. Data is your compass. Gut feeling is a starting point — not a conclusion. We test, measure, and iterate.

5. Clarity beats creativity. If a user has to think twice, we've already lost them.

6. Mobile-first, always. The majority of eCommerce traffic is mobile. If it doesn't work perfectly on mobile, it doesn't ship.

7. Speed matters. Every second of load time costs conversions. Design must consider performance.



---



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Strong experience in UX design for eCommerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar platforms)

- Solid understanding of Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) principles and best practices

- Proficiency in Figma — you must be able to design and prototype natively in Figma

- Ability to think in user journeys, funnels, and behavioral patterns

- Knowledge of A/B testing concepts (Hotjar, Google Optimize, VWO, or similar tools is a plus)

- Strong eye for UX copy — microcopy, CTAs, and headlines that convert

- Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and meet deadlines



---



HOW TO APPLY — IMPORTANT: Applications without a video will NOT be considered.



To apply, you must submit a short video (2–5 minutes) in which you:



1. Walk us through at least one Figma UX design you created for an eCommerce context (product page, checkout, landing page, etc.)

2. Explain WHY you made specific design decisions — focus on conversion and user behavior, not aesthetics

3. If you don't have existing eCommerce projects: Pick any real online store, identify a UX/CRO problem on it, and show us how you would redesign or improve it in Figma. We are more interested in how you THINK than what you've already done.



Your video should demonstrate: clear thinking, knowledge of eCommerce UX, and a conversion-first mindset.



No video = no review. This is non-negotiable.



---



We look forward to meeting designers who design with purpose.
